digest.component_or_area: store git operations and contention handling
propositions: High local concurrency of rebar agents contends on shared git lock files (.git/index.lock, HEAD.lock, packed-refs.lock) with no contention policy, causing errors to surface to agents instead of being absorbed silently.

Local-only git call sites across compact, delete, fsck, txn, event_append, and metrics modules are unbounded or have inadequate timeout bounds, risking indefinite stalls while holding the store write lock.

Transient lock conflicts can be resolved automatically via per-store advisory lock (fcntl-based serialization) plus bounded jittered retry/backoff on git-level lock signatures, with only genuinely stuck locks (timeout exhausted) surfacing actionable errors.
Jitter must be applied to all retry sleeps (store lock acquisition and git lock retry) using uniform [0.75, 1.25] multiplier to de-synchronize thundering herd of concurrent writers.

Each local-only git call site must be bounded with a watchdog timeout (120s for plumbing, 300s for slow operations like blame/log) calibrated against legitimate latency, not network values, to distinguish wedged from slow.
Permanently held git locks must produce exactly one actionable error message naming the lock file and including holder remedy guidance after the bounded jittered retry budget is exhausted.
